news.title: Rupee rises 1.9% in a week, closes below 95 per dollar
news.description: The Indian rupee strengthened 1.9% this week to close at 94.96 per dollar, its strongest weekly gain in seven months. Aggressive RBI measures curbed dollar demand, while a weaker dollar index supported the currency despite corporate buying pressure.

news.title: Federal Bank Q2 profit jumps 45% to record Rs 1,386 crore
news.description: Federal Bank posted record Q2 profit of Rs 1,386 crore, up 45% year-on-year, as net interest income climbed 26%. Advances grew 22% and deposits 19%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPAs declining to 1.32% during the September quarter.
